description: Chronological axisymmetric elastic Taylor-Culick velocity and hoop-conformation fields
representative_status: Completed physical simulation used to illustrate the benchmark physics; these are not timing-run states or images of the uniform-grid benchmark execution.

time_metadata.evidence: Each value is the simulation time rendered in that decoded source frame by VideoTC_vFinal_v2.py; labels were read from the selected frames and were not inferred from video playback time or interpolated.

simulation.geometry: axisymmetric hole opening in a freestanding sheet

panels.label: ||V||/V_TC
panels.source_normalisation: raw V maximum sqrt(2)*0.95; V_TC = sqrt(2), giving the displayed maximum 0.95

crop_verification: Both crops are 652 x 215 pixels in every 2262 x 1356 source frame and are matched interiors of the same tip-following physical window. VideoTC_vFinal_v2.py plots the same sampled field on the positive and negative sides of the sheet mid-plane, so the upper/lower split preserves physical geometry and one real field sample per displayed half.

layout.colourbars: one shared colour bar per quantity

changes: Selected four chronological source frames, retained matched physical-window pixels from the velocity and hoop-conformation panels, combined their symmetry-equivalent upper and lower halves, removed unrelated panels and empty canvas, and recreated two shared colour bars from verified source-script normalisations. Field pixels were neither recomputed nor recoloured.
